    // The weight the arriving tangent gives the outgoing chord:
    // (1 - t)(1 - b)(1 + c) / 2.
    TcbIncomingForwardWeight(tension: Number, continuity: Number, bias: Number): Number
        => (1.0 - tension) * (1.0 - bias) * (1.0 + continuity) * 0.5;
